verdict.rationale: The only direct evidence is a one-line claim of "Built-in pipeline monitoring and alerts" (meltano-docs-13). Pipelines run via `meltano run` and can be scheduled through Apache Airflow, which suggests run status and alerting may depend on the external orchestrator. Missing for 10: documented per-sync run status views, log access, per-sync row counts, alert delivery to Slack, email, or webhooks, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the monitoring claim.
